title: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Conduct of Evaluations)
(1) Evaluations of emergency rescue activities of emergency rescue support agencies in response to disasters at sea shall be conducted according to the evaluation form prescribed by the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard, on the basis of the evaluation items under the subparagraphs of Article 62 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree").
(2) Detailed standards for each evaluation item under the subparagraphs of Article 62 (1) of the Decree shall be prescribed by the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard.
